audience: HR teams who manage employees, leave and payroll in Jet HR

useCases.title: See who is on leave and which requests are pending
useCases.text: The AI lists leave, sickness and remote-work requests with status, kind, dates and hours, and matches them to employees.

useCases.title: Find employees whose contract ends soon
useCases.text: The AI reads employee records with contract dates and probation end, and lists the ones that end in the period you ask about.

useCases.title: Create, approve, reject or delete a leave request
useCases.text: The AI creates a leave request for an employee, approves or rejects one (with a rejection reason), or deletes it for good.

useCases.title: Review clockings and overtime
useCases.text: The AI lists time-clock events (in, out, break start and end, overtime) with employee, time, method and workplace.

useCases.title: Check payrolls, payslips and bonuses
useCases.text: The AI lists monthly payrolls with status and totals, payslips for an employee, year or month, and the bonuses recorded in payroll.

useCases.title: Create an expense reimbursement request
useCases.text: The AI creates a reimbursement request for an employee after checking the expense policies and the requests already filed. Receipts are added in Jet HR.
